title: held --ref origin/main reads a host project whose origin has no item directory yet (second-project run)
goal: held --ref REF on a project whose REF has no item directory yet lists no claim and exits 0, naming that the ref has no items

run:
import os, subprocess, sys, tempfile
t = tempfile.mkdtemp()
def g(*a):
    return subprocess.run(['git', *a], cwd=t, capture_output=True, text=True, check=True).stdout
g('init', '-q', '-b', 'main'); g('config', 'user.email', 'a@b.c'); g('config', 'user.name', 'n')
open(os.path.join(t, 'README.md'), 'w').write('x\n'); g('add', '-A'); g('commit', '-q', '-m', 'first')
tool = os.path.abspath('_tools/backlog.py')
def held(ref):
    return subprocess.run([sys.executable, tool, '--root', t, 'held', '--ref', ref], capture_output=True, text=True, cwd=t, timeout=25)
assert held('no-such-ref').returncode == 2, 'a ref git cannot read still exits 2'
r = held('HEAD')
text = (r.stdout + r.stderr).lower()
assert r.returncode == 0, ('exit', r.returncode, text[-200:])
assert 'no item' in text and 'fatal' not in text, text[-200:]

notes: Run finding 7: held --ref origin/main: git ls-tree --name-only origin/main:_backlog: fatal: Not a valid object name origin/main:_backlog.
